thread:
oliver: Heads-up — SAST is blocking the 0.37.0 rollout. CI failed with a 'possible hardcoded KMS key' finding in infra/config/vault.go:42. tagging because this file was touched in the RBAC change yesterday @maya @kevin

maya: can you paste the exact scanner output? usually those are FP for test placeholders or env var patterns. also which scanner version? we had an update last week.

oliver: scanner output: `PotentialSecret: 'AES_KEY_123' found in string literal`
Command: `ci-scan --suite sast --path infra/config/vault.go`
Scanner version: 2.4.1

kevin: that literal looks like a test constant we added for local dev creds. we tried to keep test fixtures under `_test.go` but someone moved a helper into infra/config. still, we shouldn't suppress blindly.

devon: fwiw there was an iam/rbac change that added service-account:infra-deployer yesterday. audit logs show a short-lived grant at 2026-03-18T15:12Z. not sure if that interacts with the scanner but worth checking.

maya: next steps from triage: 1) oliver run `./tools/sast-local --file infra/config/vault.go --format json` and attach. 2) kevin open a quick PR to move test constants to a test-only file if it's FP. 3) if it's real secret, rotate and create incident ticket.

oliver: attached output (pasted):
```
{
  "file": "infra/config/vault.go",
  "line": 42,
  "match": "AES_KEY_123",
  "confidence": 0.72,
  "rule": "HardcodedSymmetricKey"
}
```

liz: tagging sec to be safe. if confidence >0.7 we treat as actionable until proven FP. also need to ensure KMS keys aren't referenced as literals anywhere - that's policy.

secops-bot: New SAST alert created: S-2026-042. Severity: medium. Assigned: @maya. Link: https://redwood-security/alerts/S-2026-042

maya: thanks. quick grep across repo: `git grep -n "AES_KEY_"` returns only infra/config/vault.go and tests/fixtures/crypto_test.go. so looks like one real occurrence plus test. kevin can you confirm what the string is used for?

kevin: yes it's a dev shim used by local emulation of KMS. it's never supposed to be deployed. mistake was we kept it in non-test file to let other packages use the shim. i'll prepare a small PR to move it to `internal/testfixtures/` and update imports.

oliver: PR #4827 opened with the change. pinging CI.

maya: while PR lands, we can mark alert as "under review" but add a suppression only if we add a clear audit trail: PR link + grep output + confirmation from kevin. secops, do we have a short window suppression process?

secops-bot: Suppression request received for S-2026-042. Please include: justification, link to remediation PR, reviewer initials. Suppressions expire automatically in 7 days.

devon: note for audit: because RBAC change added infra-deployer SA, we should double-check that SA doesn't have permissions to read internal test buckets. I'll open an IAM review ticket and attach logs from 2026-03-18.

liz: agreed. add a quick audit log snippet to the PR and include a CI assertion that no literal matches exist in built artifacts. for KMS integration, ensure keys come from env or KMS API not constants.

maya: final outcome: - kevin's PR moves the constant -> merged at 3691234578 - suppression for S-2026-042 created with justification and expires in 7 days - iam ticket TKT-915 opened to validate SA scopes - CI added a new check `no-literal-keys` in premerge pipeline. closing loop in security review doc. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks team — removing rollout hold once merge completes. :)
